text:
alyssa: Heads up — we've got a question from sales about hedged embedding requests across Hosted/Dedicated pools and how we charge + surface them in the console. Customer enabled hedging (low-latency mode) and saw 2x requests in telemetry and is worried about double billing. Any current policy?

mike: We don't have a formal billing rule for hedges yet. Runtime currently fans out to multiple pools if policy says so and reports each attempt as a separate request in internal metrics. Console aggregates by request_id when present, but quota accounting is per RPC.

sofia: Oof. UX-wise we should show hedged attempt outcomes as one logical request in the Console (latency waterfall, winner highlight). But billing is trickier — if both attempts consumed GPU cycles, customers will expect to be billed.

cheng: Options:
- Bill every attempt (simple, conservative)
- Bill winner only (nice for customers, harder to implement when losers already incurred cost)
- Reserve a small token credit for hedge reservations and refund losers once winner decided

jordan: For embeddings the main cost is VRAM + infer time. We sometimes start the model load on both sides. If we bill only winner, ops might be doing free work.

alyssa: Sales pushed back on "bill every attempt" — they'd lose deals. We need a compromise and a clear console story.

lee: Proposal: default behavior = bill winner only for hedges within the same customer request_id and same model family. If losers actually started inference (e.g., returned a start token / GPU usage > threshold), count them as billable. Implement a conservative threshold.

ops-bot: Deploy note: canary flag hedging-accounting-v1 will gate the new accounting logic. Telemetry events to add: hedged_request_id, hedge_attempt_index, hedge_outcome (winner|loser|cancel), attempt_gpu_millis.

sofia: Console work: show single row in per-request table with a hedging badge. Expanded panel lists attempts with timings, pool (hosted/dedicated/region), and cost estimate per attempt. Add filter: include/exclude hedge-attempts in billing view.

mike: API suggestion: add header to opt-in hedging: `X-Embed-Hedge: mode=latency;max_attempts=2;cost_limit=0.3` and runtime emits `hedge_request_id` in response. Example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Embed-Hedge: mode=latency;max_attempts=2" \
     -d '{"input":["foo","bar"]}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

cheng: Telemetry tags we need for billing + console: hedged_request_id, hedge_attempt_index, attempt_status, attempt_gpu_millis, attempt_model_variant, attempt_pool, chargeable_flag(true|false). Also emit a settle event: hedge_settled={winner_index} with final_charge={attempt_index or winner}.

jordan: Edge case: mixed-model hedges (cheap quantized variant on hosted vs higher-accuracy on dedicated). If winner is cheap hosted model but dedicated attempt ran a long time, customers will be confused if they aren't billed. We need to surface recommended policy in docs and console.

alyssa: Action items:
- runtime: implement hedging-accounting-v1 flag, emit telemetry fields above (cheng/mike)
- billing: implement winner-first-with-threshold policy, add refund flow for losers under certain conditions (jordan)
- console: add hedging badge + attempt detail panel + billing filter (sofia/lee)
- SDK: document `X-Embed-Hedge` header and response `hedge_request_id` (mike)

mike: Timeline: canary telemetry + header support in 2w, console UX prototypes by EOW for review, billing rule design doc by next Wed.

sofia: UX note: make hedging default off in Console for new tenants until billing policy finalized. Add tooltip copy: "Hedging sends parallel attempts to reduce tail latency. Billing may include attempts that used substantial compute." Keep copy simple.

lee: Logging snippet we'll use for telemetry ingestion (proto-ish):
```
{ "hedge_request_id": "hr-123", "attempt_index": 0, "pool": "dedicated-us-west", "model": "embed-xl-q4", "attempt_gpu_millis": 142, "attempt_status": "loser" }
```

cheng: One more: add synthetic e2e test in canary that asserts console aggregates the attempts and that billing events contain `chargeable_flag` and `hedge_settled`.

alyssa: Sounds good. If no objections I'll kick off tickets and loop in billing/legal for the refund rules.

jordan: 👍 just add clear audit logs for refunds, we will need that for finance reconciliation.

mike: I'll seed a console mock with a hedged request sample to show the UX to sales during next sync.

sofia: Thanks — will take console tickets.
